name: Input Stage
description: Receives STRIDE-scored canonical graph from Agent 04

name: Generation Stage
description: Analyzes high-risk flows and generates concrete threats with MITRE ATT&CK mappings

name: Output Stage
description: Emits threat-populated canonical graph to orchestrator

name: Graph Fetcher
description: Retrieves STRIDE-scored canonical graph from Agent 04 state; identifies flows scoring 3+ on any STRIDE dimension

name: Context Analyzer
description: Extracts threat context for high-risk flows (trust boundary names component functions interfaces protocol types); prepares LLM prompt

name: LLM Prompt Handler
description: Constructs Agent 05 system prompt (threat generation rules) and user prompt (high-risk flows with context); calls LLM

name: Threat Generator
description: Extracts threat objects from LLM response (name description MITRE ATT&CK CAPEC CWE likelihood impact); populates threats array for each qualifying flow

name: Validation Engine
description: Validates threat objects (non-empty name/description valid MITRE IDs likelihood/impact 1-5); ensures schema compliance; rejects non-compliant threats

name: State Emitter
description: Serializes threat-populated canonical graph; returns to orchestrator for Agent 06
